items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We were talking, I remember Baby Dodds once told me you're the only one that still uses the Chinese crags.

ctx.x: I use that. I do that quite a bit. I mean, I always try and keep an after beat with the sock cymbal too.
